SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date_column, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'register' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) as totalRegUser, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'recharge' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) as totalChargeUser, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'order' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) as totalCharge, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'signin' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) as totalSignIn FROM (
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(u.create_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as date_column, 'register' as source, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM tb_user u
AND u.agent = #{currentUserId}
AND u.salesmanid = #{currentUserId}
AND u.create_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND u.create_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(u.create_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(co.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date_column, 'recharge' as source, COUNT(DISTINCT co.user_id) as cnt FROM tb_charge_order co LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON co.user_id = u.id
AND u.agent = #{currentUserId}
AND u.salesmanid = #{currentUserId}
AND co.create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND co.create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(co.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(co.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date_column, 'order' as source, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM tb_charge_order co LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON co.user_id = u.id
AND u.agent = #{currentUserId}
AND u.salesmanid = #{currentUserId}
AND co.create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND co.create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(co.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(usi.sign_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date_column, 'signin' as source, COUNT(DISTINCT usi.user_id) as cnt FROM tb_user_sign_in usi LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON usi.user_id = u.id
AND u.agent = #{currentUserId}
AND u.salesmanid = #{currentUserId}
AND usi.sign_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND usi.sign_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(usi.sign_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ) combined_data GROUP BY date_column ORDER BY date_column

SELECT CONCAT(year_val, '-W', week_val) as date, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'register' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) as newRegisteredMembers, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'recharge' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) as newRechargeMembers, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'order' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) as rechargeOrderCount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'signin' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) as signInCount FROM (
SELECT YEAR(create_date) as year_val, WEEK(create_date) as week_val, MIN(create_date) as date_column, 'register' as source, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM tb_user
AND create_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND create_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
GROUP BY YEAR(create_date), WEEK(create_date)
UNION ALL
SELECT YEAR(create_time) as year_val, WEEK(create_time) as week_val, MIN(create_time) as date_column, 'recharge' as source, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as cnt FROM tb_charge_order
AND create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
GROUP BY YEAR(create_time), WEEK(create_time)
UNION ALL
SELECT YEAR(create_time) as year_val, WEEK(create_time) as week_val, MIN(create_time) as date_column, 'order' as source, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM tb_charge_order
AND create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
GROUP BY YEAR(create_time), WEEK(create_time)
UNION ALL
SELECT YEAR(sign_time) as year_val, WEEK(sign_time) as week_val, MIN(sign_time) as date_column, 'signin' as source, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as cnt FROM tb_user_sign_in
AND sign_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}/1000)
AND sign_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime}/1000)
GROUP BY YEAR(sign_time), WEEK(sign_time) ) combined_data GROUP BY year_val, week_val ORDER BY year_val, week_val
